White flip-top cap, easy to open with one hand in the shower
description: VERDA Hydrating Shampoo is a daily shampoo with aloe and oat for anyone who wants clean hair and 72-hour hydration from one simple step. It cleanses hair and scalp as part of an everyday routine, with aloe and oat at the centre of the formula. Use it each time you wash. Massage into wet hair, work into a lather, rinse. Repeat if you like, then follow with your usual conditioner. The white flip-top cap opens and closes with one hand, so there is no lid to set down or lose in the shower. The matte, soft-touch bottle holds 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz and sits quietly on a bath shelf beside stone, cotton and daylight. A calm, plain shampoo for the days you want your routine to stay simple.
